label: Habermas formulated universal pragmatics in part to overcome relativistic threats posed by Kuhnian incommensurability
description: Jürgen Habermas formulated a fundamental critique of "Incommensurability", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Incommensurability".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Contemporary & Post-Structural.
